integrity: Original Nijenhuis equation algebraically verified; two independent finite consistency programs included. Priority is literature-qualified, not independently certified.
limitations: Only rank-one k-linear associative Nijenhuis maps on finite étale commutative k-algebras are classified; arbitrary-rank, nonreduced, and inseparable cases are not treated. A more general unlocated result could imply the classification.
title: Rank-one associative Nijenhuis operators on finite étale algebras
